title: feat: ObjectDataTable/ObjectPivotTable async data loading, context-aware WidgetConfigPanel, and dashboard UX improvements
body:
Dashboard table/pivot widgets lacked object provider support, the config panel was one-size-fits-all regardless of widget type, and several UX issues (overflow, empty states, I18nLabel rendering) needed addressing. ### P0: Object/Provider Support (Table & Pivot) Created two new async-aware wrapper components following the established `ObjectChart` pattern: - **`ObjectPivotTable`** — Fetches records via `dataSource.find()` from `SchemaRendererContext`, renders skeleton loading → error state → empty state → `PivotTable` with fetched data. Registered as `object-pivot` in `ComponentRegistry`. - **`ObjectDataTable`** — Same async lifecycle (skeleton/error/empty), plus auto-derives columns from fetched data keys when no explicit columns are configured. Registered as `object-data-table` in `ComponentRegistry`. - **`DashboardRenderer` routing**: Table widgets with `objectName` or `provider: 'object'` are now routed to `object-data-table`; pivot widgets are routed to `object-pivot`. Static data tables/pivots continue using `data-table` and `pivot` types directly. No more passing `data: []` for object-bound widgets. ### P1: Context-aware WidgetConfigPanel Sections now show/hide via `visibleWhen` predicates based on `draft.type`: - **Pivot** → Data, Rows (field, sort by/order via `icon-group` toggle, show label, show totals), Columns (same), Values (field, aggregation, number format) - **Chart** → Axis & Series (x/y labels, show legend) - **Table** → Columns (searchable, pagination) - Breadcrumb adapts: `"Pivot table"` / `"Table"` / `"Chart"` / `"Widget"` via `BREADCRUMB_LABELS` lookup - Sort by uses compact `icon-group` controls (`Group | Value`), Sort order uses `↑ | ↓` toggles (Airtable visual parity) - `resolveLabel()` pre-processes `title`/`description` config values so `{key, defaultValue}` I18nLabel objects render as strings instead of `[object Object]` ### P2: Pivot widget type registration - Added `'pivot'` to `DASHBOARD_WIDGET_TYPES` in `@object-ui/types` - Added `Pivot Table` option in WidgetConfigPanel dropdown ### P3: Responsive grid and metric card fixes - **Grid column clamping**: `layout.w` clamped to `Math.min(w, columns)` preventing overflow - **MetricWidget**: `overflow-hidden` on Card, `truncate` on label/value/description, `shrink-0` on icon/trend ### P4: Detail experience polish - **PivotTable**: friendly empty state with grid icon + "No data available" (replaces empty ``) - **PivotTable**: improved total/subtotal row styling — `bg-muted/40` on tfoot, `bg-muted/20` on row-total column, `font-bold` on grand total - **Widget description**: rendered in card headers via `resolveLabel()` with `line-clamp-2` ### Tests 29 new tests (188 total): ObjectPivotTable (8), ObjectDataTable (6), context-aware sections (6), I18nLabel resolution (2), pivot type option (1), pivot object binding (1), description rendering (2), grid clamping (1), pivot empty state (2). CodeQL security scan clean.
Original prompt > > ---- > > *This section details on the original issue you should resolve* > > 【需求/优化】Dashboard 表格类（Table/Pivot）widget 支持 object 数据+上下文感知配置面板优化 > ### 目标 > 全面提升 Dashboard 表格类（Table/Pivot）组件体验，支持 object provider（异步数据），并为各类 widget 区分专属的配置面板。 > > --- > > #### 需修改&优化的细节清单 > > **P0. object/provider 支持（Table & Pivot）** > - [ ] 新增 / 改造 `ObjectDataTable`、`ObjectPivotTable` 组件，实现 schema 中配置 `{dataProvider, objectName}` 之后自动加载数据，填充表格 > - 加载中显示 skeleton，异常显示错误提示，空数据有友好提示 > - 支持 columns/rows/value 字段自动推导（如无则根据 metadata 自动生成） > - 同���支持 pivot 类型，解决当前 pivot widget 空数据无渲染、无加载的问题 > - [ ] `DashboardRenderer` 里 Table 与 Pivot 都应根据 provider/objectName 自动选择正确渲染器，并统一传递 config（不能一直 data: []） > > **P1. WidgetConfigPanel 全面上下文感知（动态渲染）** > - [ ] 配置面板根据 widget type 动态生成： > - Table 类型支持自定义 columns（含排序、宽度、显示/隐藏、label） > - Pivot 类型支持 Rows、Columns、Values、Show Totals、Sort by 等完整配置 > - Chart 类型展示 axis、series、legend 等专属面板 > - [ ] 支持选项的拖动排序、switch、toggle，控件信息密度、交互细节参考 Airtable > - [ ] 目前 Title、Description 字段如果是 I18nLabel 格式，统一预处理（resolveLabel）避免显示 [object Object] > - [ ] 配置面板视觉密度提升，参考 Airtable 右侧结构优化分组、文案排版 > > **P2. 新 widget 类型补全、入口展示** > - [ ] Dashboard 新增 widget 下拉菜单补充 Pivot Table 类型 > - [ ] Widget 类型面板图标与交互优化（分组展示/置顶常用类型） > > **P3. 响应式 grid 和 metric 卡片优化** > - [ ] 卡片类 widget (如 metric) 处理 overflow/截断异常，Grid 布局自动 clamp col > > **P4. 细节体验强化** > - [ ] dashboard 下的 table/pivot 空状态信息更合适（非一律放大镜/搜索 icon） > - [ ] 完善多维表格、空行/合计行/小计行的样式细节 > > --- > **实现要求** > - 每条优化单独 commit 或 PR > - 完善对应测试用例/故事 > - 任务完成后：跑通测试，更新 ROADMAP.md，更新关联 issue > - 如需跨 repo 协作，自动创建 cross-repo 问题 > > > > > ## Comments on the Issue (you are @copilot in this section) > > > >
